built.summary:
I3 is finished. All the admin edits typecheck (`npx tsc --noEmit -p .` in frontend/admin is clean), and tablet/src/lib/printer.ts typechecks under a scratch tsconfig that resolves from rider/node_modules (also clean).

1. **Refund money taken (the one that matters for Monday).** /orders/[id] now shows "Money taken: PKR x — Refund" when all three hold:
   - the order is cancelled or rejected;
   - money taken at the till is still owed back;
   - the signed-in user is a manager.

   The banner opens a dialog that posts to the refund route (`POST /pos/orders/:id/refund`). The dialog:
   - lets the manager pick the tender (only tenders that still have money left);
   - lets them enter an amount, capped at the smaller of what is owed overall and what is left on that tender;
   - asks for a reason, and a photo when the refund policy requires one.

   The server's codes are shown in plain words: NOTHING_TO_REFUND, REFUND_EXCEEDS_DUE, REFUND_METHOD_NOT_TENDERED, REFUND_EXCEEDS_TENDER and OPEN_DRAWER_REQUIRED. OVER_CAP and MANAGER_OVERRIDE_REQUIRED come through the existing refund messages. After a refund, the success line reads `refundDueLeftCents` to say how much is still owed. The amount owed is worked out on the page using the server's own rule. A scratch script compared it with the backend's `refundDueCents` on 5 cases and they matched. The header "Refund" button is now also hidden on rejected orders, where it used to open a cancel that could not succeed.

2. **Orders list Reprint.** The button now shows only when the order already has a full & final bill (completed, refunded, cancelled, rejected, or paid in full). It prints through the shared print helpers as a DUPLICATE. If the server answers 409 PRE_BILL_REQUIRED, it offers to print a pre-bill instead. I also removed the emoji icons on that page and added a "refunded" status colour and filter option.

3. **api.ts.** `ApiError` now keeps the server's `error.details`. Both error paths read the error body safely, so an HTML 502 from a proxy still becomes an `ApiError`. Content-Type is sent only when the request has a body. The one other place that builds an `ApiError` (tillApi.ts, 3 arguments) still compiles.

4. **Tablet printer.** Held sales print "Fiscal invoice: not yet issued.", and paid orders still waiting to complete print "Fiscal invoice: issued when the / order is completed." This matches the HTML bill in receipt.ts. The receipt's fiscal type gained the two optional status fields.

5. **WhatsApp connector page.** It now shows how the gateway key is stored (encrypted, plaintext, unreadable or none), with what to do for the plaintext and unreadable cases. The old "Stored encrypted" note under the key field was not always true, so I reworded it.

The finance link card is not needed (/finance only redirects; the sidebar already reaches /finance/voided-pre-bills). The connector field locking and the refund-to-card dialog were both already built, so I changed neither.

items.note: tablet/src/lib/printer.ts fiscalLines: rawStatus 'held' prints ['Fiscal invoice: not yet issued.']; statusReason 'awaiting_completion' prints ['Fiscal invoice: issued when the', 'order is completed.']; anything else keeps the old pending text. Added optional rawStatus and statusReason to ReceiptFiscal, matching what receipt.ts returns (both null on a sale with no document yet). Same three cases as the HTML bill (receipt.ts ~L500). Typechecked under a scratch tsconfig resolving from rider/node_modules: clean.

frontend/admin/src/app/orders/page.tsx: Reprint shows only when the order has a final bill (completed/refunded/cancelled/rejected, or paid rows >= totalCents, the same rule as isFinalBill). reprintReceipt now uses tillApi fetchReceiptHtml(duplicate)+printHtml; on 409 PRE_BILL_REQUIRED it asks and prints the pre-bill (printPreBill), otherwise alerts the readable error. Also removed the emoji icons (printer, fire, check, pin) and added refunded colour + filter.

frontend/admin/src/lib/api.ts: ApiError gains a 4th optional `details`. request() and download() build errors through a new errorFrom(), which keeps data.error.details and tolerates a non-JSON body (proxy 502 HTML). Content-Type: application/json only when options.body != null. Constructor callers checked: api.ts itself and components/pos/tillApi.ts:292 (3 args, still valid). tsc clean.

Admin bullets only. keyAtRest is shown on /connectors/whatsapp: a badge plus what to do for plaintext/unreadable, through a local type that extends WhatsappStatus. The finance/page.tsx link card is not needed: /finance just redirects to /accounting/pl-ledger, and /finance/voided-pre-bills is already reached through moduleCatalog/appRoles (voided_prebills). The backend bullets (media 503, _types tip_cents) belong to other streams.

Already built in components/connectors/FiscalSetup.tsx: while the fiscal POS is live, the driver and base URL inputs are disabled (locked = live || !canEdit), with a banner saying why. connectorErrorText already maps 409 SWITCH_OFF_FIRST. These match the server's switchOffFirst checks (driver, baseUrl).

Already built in app/refunds (RefundOptions.tsx + refundEngine.ts, not my files). The photo upload is sent when policy.requirePhotoEvidence is on (refundChoiceReady blocks without it). refundErrorMessage shows OVER_CAP and MANAGER_OVERRIDE_REQUIRED, and refundOnCardMachine passes photoUrl. Nothing to change.

frontend/admin/src/app/orders/[id]/page.tsx: shows 'Money taken: PKR x — Refund' only when status is cancelled/rejected, money is still owed back, and useIsManager() is true. The owed amount mirrors the server's refundDueCents (drawer receipts on a shift, comps excluded, less refunds handed back), with the per-tender split from refundDueOf. The MoneyTakenModal sends POST /pos/orders/:id/refund {amountCents, reason, method, photoUrl?} through refundThroughEngine (its manager-PIN prompt applies). It maps NOTHING_TO_REFUND / REFUND_EXCEEDS_DUE / REFUND_METHOD_NOT_TENDERED / REFUND_EXCEEDS_TENDER / OPEN_DRAWER_REQUIRED; OVER_CAP and MANAGER_OVERRIDE_REQUIRED go through refundErrorMessage. It reports refundDueLeftCents, then refreshes the order and the fiscal panel. The header Refund/Cancel button is hidden for rejected orders too.

built.tests:
- `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` in frontend/admin: clean, after all edits.
- tablet: tablet/ has no node_modules, so I typechecked printer.ts (and the api.ts it imports) with a scratch tsconfig in the scratchpad (`tabletc/tsconfig.json`). It extends rider/node_modules/expo/tsconfig.base.json and resolves from rider/node_modules: clean.
- The admin has no test runner. To check the money-owed rule, a scratch tsx script compared the page's moneyTakenOf against the backend's real refundDueCents on 5 cases: cash only; cash+card with a part refund; a pending gateway card plus a comp; no shift; a completed order. All matched (5000/5000, 6000/6000, 3000/3000, 0/0, 0/0), with the expected per-tender split.
- No backend files were touched, so the backend suite was not re-run.
built.needsOtherFiles:
1. frontend/admin/src/lib/connectorsApi.ts (optional): add `keyAtRest?: 'none' | 'encrypted' | 'plaintext' | 'unreadable'` to `interface WhatsappStatus`. The WhatsApp page declares it locally for now, as `type WhatsappView = WhatsappStatus & { keyAtRest?: … }`. Once it is on WhatsappStatus, the local type can go.
2. frontend/admin/src/components/pos/tillApi.ts:292 (optional): pass the 4th argument, `new ApiError(res.status, body?.error?.code ?? 'PRINT_FAILED', body?.error?.message ?? …, body?.error?.details)`, so printable-page errors keep details like every other API error.
3. frontend/admin/src/lib/api.ts `ordersApi.cancel` is now only used by the orders list's bulk cancel and sends `{reason}` with no manager PIN. A non-manager's bulk cancel gets 403 MANAGER_OVERRIDE_REQUIRED, which the bulk bar shows as an alert. That is acceptable, but if the owner wants bulk cancel for cashiers, it should call refundEngine `cancelOrderWithApproval` with one PIN prompt. No change is required.
4. Backend (optional), connectors/terminal/service.ts and pos/service.ts `assertRefundAllowed`: a card-machine refund on a CANCELLED/REJECTED ticket is refused (assertRefundableStatus throws NOT_REFUNDABLE). So the new 'Refund money taken' dialog records a card hand-back as a manual card refund, which staff make on the machine by hand. To refund those through the machine, assertRefundAllowed needs a branch that checks refundDueOf / assertRefundDue for cancelled and rejected orders, the way refundOrder already does.
built.prodNotes:
- **Refund money taken (new on the order page).** A manager opens the order and taps Refund on the "Money taken: PKR x" banner. The banner appears only when a cancelled or rejected ticket still holds till money, and only for managers.
  - Cash comes out of the manager's own open drawer. With no shift open they get "open your shift at the till first".
  - Card and Keenu QR hand-backs are records only: staff refund on the machine or Keenu by hand first. servd cannot yet drive a card-machine refund on a cancelled ticket (needsOtherFiles 4).
  - The order stays cancelled, and nothing goes to the fiscal POS.
- **Orders list.** Reprint now appears only for orders that have a full & final bill, and every reprint is marked DUPLICATE. An unpaid order is offered a pre-bill (not a tax invoice) instead.
- **Tablet bills.** Held sales now print "Fiscal invoice: not yet issued.", and paid online orders not yet completed print "Fiscal invoice: issued when the order is completed." This closes prodNotes item 3 of the W4 cutover. Tablets need a new build to pick it up; Expo was not run here.
- **Admin API client.** It no longer sends Content-Type on requests without a body (GET, DELETE, empty POST). A non-JSON error page (a Cloudflare 502) now shows as "Request failed (502)" instead of a JavaScript error.
- **WhatsApp connector page.** It now warns when the gateway key is stored unencrypted (SERVD_SECRET_KEY not on the box) or is unreadable (the box's SERVD_SECRET_KEY differs from the one that encrypted the key: re-enter the key).
